name: Service Level Agreement
description: Service level terms for a cloud service, covering target uptime, downtime calculation, support response times and service credits.

coverPage.title: Service Level Agreement
coverPage.intro: This Service Level Agreement (the “Agreement”) consists of: (1) this Cover Page (“**Cover Page**”) and (2) the Common Paper Service Level Agreement Standard Terms (“**Standard Terms**”). Any modifications of the Standard Terms should be made on the Cover Page, which will control over conflicts with the Standard Terms.
coverPage.attestation: By signing this Cover Page, each party agrees to enter into this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
coverPage.attribution: Common Paper Service Level Agreement free to use under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

fields.label: Provider
fields.prompt: the provider's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address.

fields.label: Customer
fields.prompt: the customer's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.prompt: the period the service levels are measured over, such as "each calendar month".

fields.label: Target Uptime
fields.prompt: the uptime the provider commits to, such as "99.9%".

fields.label: Uptime Credit
fields.prompt: what the customer gets if uptime is missed, such as "10% of the monthly fee for each 0.1% below target".

fields.label: Target Response Time
fields.prompt: how quickly the provider answers a support request, such as "4 business hours for urgent issues".

fields.label: Response Time Credit
fields.prompt: what the customer gets if a response time is missed.

fields.label: Support Channel
fields.prompt: how the customer raises a support request, such as "support@provider.com".

fields.label: Scheduled Downtime
fields.prompt: the maintenance windows that do not count against uptime, such as "Sundays 02:00-06:00 UTC, with 48 hours notice".
